description: Report what you are doing on a criterion you have claimed, without changing its status. This is the heartbeat the board shows live: call it at every phase change (planning, writing_test, implementing, running_tests, waiting_ci) and at least every 3 minutes while working. Optionally attach your step plan, the files you have touched and the latest test counts.

files.description: Repo-relative paths you have changed so far (max 200)

phase.description: What you are doing right now

plan.description: Your step plan; resend it with done flags updated as you go (max 50)

name: vibemap_report_progress
